categories.name: Business & Strategy
categories.description: The foundational documents that explain what AirTrek is, who it's for, and how it makes money.

categories.name: Product & Design
categories.description: What the user experiences — screens, flows, brand, and the systems that drive engagement.

categories.name: Technical Architecture
categories.description: How the system is built — services, databases, APIs, and how they connect together.

categories.name: Development
categories.description: The actual software to build — each service is a building block of the platform.

categories.name: Content & Cultural
categories.description: The heart of AirTrek — stories, characters, destinations, and cultural knowledge.

categories.name: Operations
categories.description: How we keep the system running, handle problems, and deploy updates safely.

categories.name: Legal & Compliance
categories.description: Documents that protect us and our users — terms, privacy, ethics.

categories.name: Testing & Quality
categories.description: How we verify everything works correctly before users see it.

deliverables.title: Executive Summary
deliverables.description: One-page overview of AirTrek for investors and partners. Covers the vision, the problem we solve, our solution, target market, and business model.
deliverables.plainLanguage: A single page that explains AirTrek to anyone in under 2 minutes. Think of it as the elevator pitch in written form.

deliverables.title: Business Model Canvas
deliverables.description: Visual one-page map of how AirTrek creates, delivers, and captures value. Covers key partners, activities, resources, value propositions, customer relationships, channels, segments, cost structure, and revenue streams.
deliverables.plainLanguage: A visual map (one big page) showing the entire business at a glance: who pays us, what we offer, how we deliver it, and what it costs.

deliverables.title: Revenue Model & Pricing Tiers
deliverables.description: Defines the four tiers (Free, Explorer, Voyager, Patron) with pricing, features included, Trekcoin allowances, and upgrade incentives.
deliverables.plainLanguage: How much we charge, what each plan includes, and how we encourage users to upgrade. Like Netflix plans but for cultural exploration.

deliverables.title: Market Analysis
deliverables.description: Research into competitors, market size, target demographics, trends in AI-powered education and cultural tourism technology.
deliverables.plainLanguage: Who else does something similar? How big is our potential market? Why is now the right time for AirTrek?

deliverables.title: Go-to-Market Strategy
deliverables.description: Launch plan covering marketing channels, partnerships (cultural institutions, travel industry, education), timeline, and growth targets.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The plan for how we actually get users. Where do we advertise? Who do we partner with? What happens week 1, month 1, year 1?

deliverables.title: Financial Projections
deliverables.description: Revenue forecasts, cost estimates (API costs, infrastructure, staffing), break-even analysis, and funding requirements for Years 1-3.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The money math: how much we'll make, how much it costs to run, and when we start turning a profit.

deliverables.title: Product Requirements Document
deliverables.description: Complete feature list with priorities (must-have, should-have, nice-to-have) for the AirTrek MVP and future releases.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The full shopping list of features: what we absolutely need for launch, what would be nice, and what can wait.

deliverables.title: User Personas
deliverables.description: 3-5 detailed profiles of target users: travelers, educators, culture enthusiasts, students, digital nomads. Demographics, goals, pain points, tech comfort level.
deliverables.plainLanguage: Imaginary but realistic profiles of the people who will use AirTrek. Helps everyone on the team design for real humans, not abstract 'users.'

deliverables.title: User Journey Maps
deliverables.description: Step-by-step flows: sign up, first conversation, earning Trekcoin, unlocking a milestone, voice synthesis, song generation.
deliverables.plainLanguage: Comic-strip-style walkthroughs of what a user does from the moment they find AirTrek to becoming a regular user.

deliverables.title: Wireframes & Mockups
deliverables.description: Screen designs for the web app (chat interface, passport view, settings), mobile views, and the admin dashboard.
deliverables.plainLanguage: Drawings/pictures of what every screen in AirTrek looks like. First rough sketches, then polished designs.

deliverables.title: Brand Guidelines
deliverables.description: Logo usage, color palette, typography, tone of voice, visual style, iconography. The complete brand identity system.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The rulebook for how AirTrek looks and sounds everywhere — website, social media, emails, presentations.

deliverables.title: Trekcoin Economy Design
deliverables.description: Complete virtual economy: earn rates, spend costs, daily caps per tier, inflation controls, welcome bonus, milestone rewards.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The rules of AirTrek's virtual currency. How users earn coins, what they spend them on, and how we prevent the economy from breaking.

deliverables.title: Empathy (Kappa) System Design
deliverables.description: How the kappa score is calculated from 6 signals (question depth, perspective adoption, assumption surfacing, engagement duration, topic exploration, emotional resonance). Weights, smoothing, level thresholds.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The scoring system that measures how deeply a user engages with different cultures. Higher empathy = more access and rewards.

deliverables.title: Character & Persona Bible
deliverables.description: All AI characters: names, origins, eras, personalities, speaking styles, expertise areas, backstories, voice descriptions, behavior boundaries.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The character encyclopedia. Every AI guide in AirTrek described in detail so they feel like real people with real personalities.

deliverables.title: System Architecture Overview
deliverables.description: Dev/Prod topology, component mapping, data flow, tag hierarchy, environment matrix, security boundaries, scaling strategy.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The master blueprint showing every piece of AirTrek and how they connect — like an architect's plan for a building.

deliverables.title: Control Narratives
deliverables.description: ISA-88 compliant procedural narratives for all system operations: auth, chat, voice, song, economy, passport, health checks, maintenance, deployment, exception handling.
deliverables.plainLanguage: Step-by-step recipes for everything the system does — like a cookbook for the software. Uses industry-standard format (ISA-88).

deliverables.title: API Specification
deliverables.description: OpenAPI/Swagger spec for every endpoint: request/response schemas, authentication, error codes, rate limits.
deliverables.plainLanguage: A precise contract for how every 'door' in the system works — what you send, what you get back, and what can go wrong.

deliverables.title: Database Schema
deliverables.description: All tables, fields, relationships, indexes, and constraints. Entity-relationship diagram. Migration strategy.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The design for how we organize and store all data — user accounts, conversations, Trekcoin balances, passport progress.

deliverables.title: Security Architecture
deliverables.description: Authentication flows, encryption (at rest and in transit), access control model, threat model, security boundaries.
deliverables.plainLanguage: How we protect user data and prevent hacking. The security plan for the entire system.

deliverables.title: Infrastructure Plan
deliverables.description: Server specifications, container orchestration, scaling rules, cost estimates per tier, disaster recovery.
deliverables.plainLanguage: What computers we need, how much they cost, and how we handle growing from 100 to 100,000 users.

deliverables.title: Integration Map
deliverables.description: How we connect to external services: Mistral AI, ElevenLabs, Suno, Supabase. API keys, rate limits, fallback strategies.
deliverables.plainLanguage: A map of all the outside services AirTrek relies on — what they do for us, what they cost, and what happens if they go down.

deliverables.title: Tag Hierarchy (ISA-95)
deliverables.description: Complete ISA-95 tag structure for monitoring and control: gateway, services, sessions, jobs, metrics, alarms, config.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The naming system for every piece of data we monitor — like an organized filing system for all system measurements.

deliverables.title: Project Scaffolding
deliverables.description: Repository structure, build tools (Vite), CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions), Docker configuration, development environment setup.
deliverables.plainLanguage: Setting up the construction site — all the tools and structure developers need before they can start building features.

deliverables.title: Authentication Service
deliverables.description: Sign up, log in, sessions, password reset, account lockout, JWT token management. Implements CN-AUTH-001 and CN-AUTH-002.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The system that handles user accounts — signing up, logging in, and keeping accounts secure.

deliverables.title: Triad Engine
deliverables.description: Core AI conversation system: Router (epsilon), Local guide (lambda), Teacher (mu), Mirror (nu), Compositor (omega). Implements CN-CHAT-001.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The brain of AirTrek — the AI system that powers all conversations with cultural characters. Three AI agents work together for each response.

deliverables.title: Voice Service
deliverables.description: Text-to-speech via ElevenLabs API with character-specific voices and emotion mapping. Implements CN-VOICE-001.
deliverables.plainLanguage: Makes the AI characters speak out loud with unique voices that change based on the emotion of the conversation.

deliverables.title: Song Service
deliverables.description: AI song generation from conversation emotional arcs via Suno Bridge. Async job processing. Implements CN-SONG-001.
deliverables.plainLanguage: Creates personalized songs based on the emotional journey of a conversation. Each song is unique to that experience.

deliverables.title: Passport Service
deliverables.description: User progress tracking: journeys, destinations visited, kappa history, milestones. Implements CN-PASS-001 and CN-PASS-002.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The user's travel passport — tracks everywhere they've been, what they've learned, and achievements they've earned.

deliverables.title: Economy Service (Trekcoin)
deliverables.description: Credit/debit ledger, daily caps, tier discounts, transaction history, balance management. Implements CN-ECON-001 and CN-ECON-002.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The bank for Trekcoin — handles earning, spending, and keeping accurate balances for every user.

deliverables.title: TrekCube (3D Spatial)
deliverables.description: 3D world map interface, VR-ready spatial experience, destination visualization, journey path rendering.
deliverables.plainLanguage: A 3D globe where users can see and explore destinations visually — like Google Earth meets a cultural museum.

deliverables.title: Compost (Wisdom DAO)
deliverables.description: Community wisdom artifacts, DAO-style governance feed, user-contributed cultural insights.
deliverables.plainLanguage: A community garden of wisdom — where the best cultural insights from conversations are preserved and shared.

deliverables.title: Cultural Packs Service
deliverables.description: Loadable cultural content packs for destinations. Content management, versioning, and delivery.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The content delivery system — packages of cultural knowledge that can be loaded for each destination.

deliverables.title: Web Application (Frontend)
deliverables.description: React application: chat interface, passport view, Trekcoin wallet, settings, voice player, responsive design.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The website/app that users actually see and interact with — all the screens, buttons, and visual elements.

deliverables.title: Admin Dashboard
deliverables.description: Perspective screens for monitoring, user management, content administration, analytics.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The control panel for the AirTrek team — manage users, monitor system health, review content, and see analytics.

deliverables.title: Destination Library
deliverables.description: All travel destinations with history, culture, local knowledge, conversation topics, and character assignments.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The encyclopedia of places in AirTrek — everything about each destination that the AI needs to know.

deliverables.title: Character Catalog
deliverables.description: Implementation-ready character profiles with system prompts, persona configs, voice mappings, and behavior rules.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The detailed character files that the AI actually uses — turning the Character Bible into technical instructions.

deliverables.title: Cultural Pack: Japan
deliverables.description: Pilot cultural pack covering Japanese history, traditions, language basics, etiquette, cuisine, art, and philosophy.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The first complete cultural experience — Japan as the pilot destination. This sets the template for all future packs.

deliverables.title: Conversation Starters
deliverables.description: Pre-written prompts to help new users begin engaging: categorized by destination, topic, difficulty level.
deliverables.plainLanguage: Suggested questions users can pick to get started — like conversation ice-breakers for each character and destination.

deliverables.title: Educational Content
deliverables.description: Learning materials tied to empathy levels and destinations: articles, quizzes, cultural insights, reflection prompts.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The learning content — articles, quizzes, and reflection activities that deepen understanding at each empathy level.

deliverables.title: Milestone Definitions
deliverables.description: All achievements: names, descriptions, trigger conditions (count/threshold/streak), rewards, badge designs.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The achievement system — all the badges users can earn, what triggers them, and what rewards they give.

deliverables.title: Deployment Runbook
deliverables.description: Step-by-step guide for deploying updates: pre-checks, rolling updates, migration, verification, rollback. Based on CN-OPS-003.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The checklist for safely pushing updates to the live system — like a pilot's pre-flight checklist.

deliverables.title: Monitoring & Alerting Setup
deliverables.description: What we monitor, alert thresholds, notification channels, escalation paths. Based on CN-OPS-001.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The alarm system — what we watch 24/7, when we sound the alarm, and who gets notified.

deliverables.title: Maintenance Procedures
deliverables.description: Weekly maintenance: database cleanup, log rotation, backup verification, session cleanup. Based on CN-OPS-002.
deliverables.plainLanguage: Regular housekeeping tasks — like cleaning, organizing, and checking that backups work. Done every Sunday.

deliverables.title: Backup & Recovery Plan
deliverables.description: Backup schedules, retention policy, recovery procedures, RTO/RPO targets, disaster recovery testing.
deliverables.plainLanguage: How we save copies of everything and how fast we can restore them if something goes catastrophically wrong.

deliverables.title: Incident Response Playbook
deliverables.description: What to do when things break: severity levels, response procedures, communication templates, post-mortem process. Based on CN-EXC-001/002.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The emergency handbook — step-by-step instructions for when things go wrong, from minor hiccups to major outages.

deliverables.title: On-Call Rotation
deliverables.description: Who is responsible when, escalation paths, handoff procedures, compensation, tooling setup.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The schedule for who's 'on duty' to handle problems — like a hospital's on-call schedule for doctors.

deliverables.title: Terms of Service
deliverables.description: User agreement: acceptable use, intellectual property, liability, disputes, Trekcoin terms, AI interaction disclaimers.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The agreement users accept when they sign up — what they can and can't do, and what we're responsible for.

deliverables.title: Privacy Policy
deliverables.description: Data collection, usage, sharing, retention, user rights (access, deletion, portability), cookie policy, third-party services.
deliverables.plainLanguage: How we handle user data — what we collect, why, who sees it, and how users can control their information.

deliverables.title: Content Policy
deliverables.description: Rules for conversations: prohibited content, moderation approach, reporting mechanism, cultural sensitivity guidelines.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The rules of conversation — what topics are off-limits, how we moderate, and how users can report problems.

deliverables.title: Data Handling & Retention
deliverables.description: Data classification, retention schedules, deletion procedures, GDPR compliance, data processing agreements.
deliverables.plainLanguage: How long we keep different types of data and how we safely delete it when it's no longer needed.

deliverables.title: AI Ethics Guidelines
deliverables.description: Responsible AI use: bias prevention, cultural representation standards, transparency about AI nature, user safety guardrails.
deliverables.plainLanguage: Our principles for using AI ethically — preventing bias, being honest about AI limitations, and keeping users safe.

deliverables.title: Test Strategy
deliverables.description: Overall testing approach: unit, integration, E2E, performance, security. Coverage targets, tooling, CI integration.
deliverables.plainLanguage: The master plan for how we test everything — what tools we use, what 'good enough' looks like, and how testing fits into our workflow.

deliverables.title: API Test Suite
deliverables.description: Automated tests for every API endpoint: happy path, error cases, edge cases, authentication, rate limiting.
deliverables.plainLanguage: Robot testers that automatically check every endpoint works correctly — run them every time we make changes.

deliverables.title: Load & Performance Tests
deliverables.description: Stress testing: simulated load at 1K/10K/100K users. Latency benchmarks, throughput limits, bottleneck identification.
deliverables.plainLanguage: Simulating thousands of users at once to find out when the system starts to struggle and what breaks first.

deliverables.title: User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
deliverables.description: Real users testing real flows: registration, first conversation, voice, song, milestones. Feedback collection and analysis.
deliverables.plainLanguage: Getting real people to try AirTrek before launch and collecting their honest feedback on what works and what doesn't.

deliverables.title: Security Audit Checklist
deliverables.description: OWASP Top 10 verification, penetration testing plan, vulnerability scanning, dependency auditing.
deliverables.plainLanguage: A security inspection checklist — making sure hackers can't break in, steal data, or cause damage.
